Wireless phone charging helps keep compatible devices powered without adding another cable to the cabin.

Comfort is equally important. Heated front bucket seats and a heated steering wheel add year-round convenience, while the 8-way power driver's seat and 6-way power passenger seat make it easy to find a comfortable position. The dual-panel panoramic sliding sunroof opens up the cabin with natural light and gives this Blazer EV an even more premium atmosphere.

The Driver Confidence Package adds technology designed to support you behind the wheel. Adaptive Cruise Control can help maintain your selected following distance on the highway, while Enhanced Automatic Emergency Braking provides additional assistance when a potential frontal collision is detected. OnStar and Chevrolet Connected Services capability add another layer of connectivity while you're on the road.

Outside, the Pearl finish gives this Blazer EV a clean, upscale appearance, complemented by 19" machined-face aluminum wheels. The sleek profile gives it a distinctive EV look without sacrificing the practicality and versatility buyers expect from a Chevrolet SUV.

This 2021 Cadillac XT4 Premium Luxury in Blue represents a smart choice for buyers seeking a well-equipped compact luxury crossover with proven reliability and thoughtful design.

- Cadillac User Experience with embedded navigation and real-time traffic updates
- Wireless Apple CarPlay and Wireless Android Auto connectivity
- Bose Centerpoint Surround Sound 13-speaker audio system
- 8-way power passenger seat adjuster with lumbar support
- Heated and ventilated front seats with power lumbar massage
- Heated automatic steering wheel for winter comfort
- Cold Weather Package with heated rear seats
- Driver Awareness Package including Lane Keep Assist and IntelliBeam
- Comfort and Convenience Package for premium seating adjustability
- Automatic Emergency Braking and Following Distance Indicator
- Front and rear park assist with HD rear vision camera
- SiriusXM satellite radio with 360L programming
- 18-inch alloy wheels with all-weather floor mats
- Power liftgate and auto-dimming rear-view mirror
- Remote keyless entry and memory seat settings

The XT4 Premium Luxury combines practical everyday utility with genuine luxury appointments. The turbocharged 2.0L four-cylinder engine delivers capable performance while the nine-speed automatic transmission manages efficiency well, achieving 24 city and 30 highway MPG. You'll appreciate the responsive handling and composed ride quality that make this compact crossover equally suited for daily commuting or weekend drives.

Inside, the cabin reflects thoughtful premium engineering. The Cadillac User Experience infotainment system integrates seamlessly with your smartphone through wireless Apple CarPlay or Android Auto, while the embedded navigation system provides real-time traffic awareness when you need it. The 8-inch color display puts vital information at your fingertips, and natural voice recognition keeps your attention on the road ahead.

Comfort features distinguish this Premium Luxury model throughout the cabin. Heated and ventilated front seats adjust in multiple directions with lumbar massage functions for both driver and passenger. The heated steering wheel engages automatically during cold weather, and heated rear outboard seats ensure passenger comfort year-round. Memory settings preserve each driver's preferred seat and mirror positions, making transitions between drivers effortless.

Safety and awareness technologies work together to provide confidence behind the wheel. The Driver Awareness Package includes Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning to help maintain proper lane positioning, while IntelliBeam automatically manages your high beams for optimal visibility. Automatic Emergency Braking, Following Distance Indicator, and front and rear park assist round out your protective suite. A comprehensive airbag system and electronic stability control provide foundational security.

The 41,701-mile example has been well cared for and remains ready for years of dependable service. This is your opportunity to step into a luxury compact crossover that balances refinement, technology, and practical design.

Elegant styling, all-wheel-drive confidence, and an impressive collection of luxury technology come together in this well-equipped 2016 Mercedes-Benz C 300 4MATIC Sedan. This 2001 Ford F150 SVT Lightning is covered by the Gallery Guarantee.



With The Gallery Guarantee, you'll enjoy a 3-month/500-mile vehicle service contract and a multi-point safety inspection for ultimate peace of mind. Plus, explore exclusive warranty extension options and take advantage of our Buy Back Guarantee. It's not just a purchase; it's a promise that ensures your journey begins with confidence.



This 2001 Ford F-150 SVT Lightning combines the unmistakable styling of Ford's second-generation Lightning with substantial performance upgrades and a well-documented ownership history. Finished in Silver Metallic over the signature two-tone SVT interior, this regular-cab, short-bed performance truck retains the clean factory appearance that made the Lightning one of the most recognizable sport trucks of its era. It currently shows approximately 79,500 miles and has had just two owners, with the original owner retaining the truck from 2001 until 2022.



Under the hood is a professionally built Johnny Lightning Performance (JLP) seasoned long block featuring forged internals, installed after an engine failure associated with a head-gasket issue. The build was designed to comfortably support the truck's existing Kenne Bell 2.3-liter supercharger and approximately 20 pounds of boost. Supporting the combination are upgraded injectors, intake, fuel-system components, and tuning. The transmission has also received previous performance work. The result is a seriously quick Lightning with an estimated output of over 500 horsepower while retaining the street manners and usability that make these trucks so enjoyable.



The truck has accumulated roughly 9,000 miles since the replacement engine was installed, providing meaningful road time on the current combination. The CARFAX also documents extensive maintenance during the current ownership period, including cooling-system work, transmission-fluid service, brake service, a replacement radiator, starter, differential service, transmission seals, spark plugs, mass-air-flow sensor, and a recent alignment.



Inside, the Lightning retains its distinctive SVT two-tone sport seats, white-face instrumentation, and driver-focused factory layout. An updated Sony touchscreen head unit brings the audio system up to modern standards, while upgraded Pioneer speakers provide improved sound. The cabin presents as a largely stock-appearing Lightning interior while adding modern convenience.



Outside, the Silver Metallic finish is complemented by the Lightning-specific front fascia, side skirts, side-exit exhaust, hard tonneau cover, and chrome SVT-style wheels. Its lowered, purposeful stance remains one of the defining characteristics of the second-generation Lightning. CARFAX reports a minor accident in November 2016 involving damage to the left side and left rear, with no structural damage or airbag deployment reported.



With only two owners, long-term original ownership, a forged Johnny Lightning Performance engine, Kenne Bell supercharger, supporting modifications, updated audio, and extensive documented servicing, this 2001 Ford F-150 SVT Lightning offers a compelling combination of collectibility and considerably more performance than a stock example. It is a thoughtfully upgraded example of Ford's iconic supercharged sport truck that is ready to be driven and enjoyed.

The 2021 Ford F-150 XLT offers a blend of proven capability, comfort, and modern technology that defines what buyers expect from a full-size crew cab truck.

This truck is well-suited for buyers researching their next vehicle who prioritize flexibility, technology, and proven value. Its spacious crew cab design supports family needs, work crews, or active lifestyles, while dual-zone climate control and heated front seats add comfort in colder climates, particularly relevant for Midwest conditions like those in the Sw Mt Vernon area. The combination of power-adjustable driver and passenger seats and an Interior Work Surface provides ergonomic support and productivity for both job sites and long trips. Its connected built-in navigation system addresses everyday convenience, making it an appealing choice for those who value an efficient daily driver that also responds well to weekend projects or occasional hauling.

Under the hood, the F-150 XLT's 2.7L V6 EcoBoost engine delivers a strong balance of torque and efficiency, especially when paired with its 10-speed automatic transmission. This powertrain offers smooth acceleration and responsive shifts, meaning the truck adapts well to changing driving situations-whether merging onto highways or maneuvering through city streets. Four-wheel drive ensures dependable traction in rain, snow, or on unpaved surfaces, enhancing confidence during variable weather or job site conditions. The platform's independent front suspension contributes to a composed, stable ride that is comfortable on both daily commutes and longer journeys.

Safety is a high priority in this truck, which is equipped with a range of active and passive safety systems. Blind Spot Monitoring helps drivers stay aware of vehicles in adjacent lanes, particularly beneficial when towing or changing lanes on busy highways. The rear camera and reverse sensing system simplify parking and trailer hookups, reducing the risk of obstacles going unnoticed. Features like ABS brakes, electronic stability control, and traction control work together to maintain control in slippery or sudden-stop situations. Multiple airbags, including dual front and side impact, provide critical protection in the event of a collision.

The F-150 XLT comes well-equipped with features that enhance both usability and comfort. Key highlights include a power driver seat, power passenger seat, heated front seats, and dual-zone climate control for optimal temperature management. The connected built-in navigation system ensures reliable route guidance, while integrated trailer brake control supports smooth and safe towing operations.

When compared to other full-size crew cab trucks such as the Chevrolet Silverado 1500 and Ram 1500, the F-150 XLT distinguishes itself with its advanced EcoBoost engine and a feature-rich cabin at the XLT trim level.

*Vehicle Details*
Go electric in this new 2027 Chevrolet Bolt from Lynch Chevrolet of Kenosha, finished in Sterling Gray Metallic with a distinctive Jet Black interior with Blue & Gray Accents. The new Bolt combines everyday practicality with an EPA-estimated 262 miles of driving range on a full charge and an impressive 120 MPGe combined rating.

The Bolt features a 65-kWh propulsion battery, 11.5-kW high-voltage charging capability, 150-kW DC fast-charge capability, and a dual-level charge cord, giving you flexible charging options at home or on the road.

Inside, this Bolt is especially well equipped with the Comfort Package and Evotex Package. Highlights include heated and ventilated front seats, heated steering wheel, 8-way power driver's seat, Evotex seating surfaces, rear center armrest, automatic climate control, and an auto-dimming rearview mirror.

Technology is centered around an 11.3-inch diagonal advanced color display with Google built-in, along with an 11-inch digital Driver Information Center, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, remote vehicle start, SiriusXM, and 12V and USB-C power outlets.

Chevrolet's driver-assistance technology includes Adaptive Cruise Control, Enhanced Automatic Emergency Braking, Forward Collision Alert, Front Pedestrian and Bicyclist Braking, Blind Zone Steering Assist, Rear Cross Traffic Braking, Reverse Automatic Braking, Rear Park Assist, Intersection Automatic Emergency Braking, Side Bicyclist Alert, IntelliBeam automatic high beams, Safety Alert Seat, and HD Rear Vision Camera.

Exterior equipment includes 17-inch Silver painted aluminum wheels, LED headlights and taillamps, and all-weather floor liners.

This CARFAX 1-OWNER, locally owned and traded Gladiator was exceptionally well equipped from the factory, carrying an original MSRP of $70,905 and more than $24,000 in options. Under the hood is the proven 3.6L V6 paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission, while the available Selec-Trac Full-Time 4WD System adds even more flexibility for changing road and trail conditions.

This Mojave is absolutely loaded with factory packages. The Dual Top Group gives you both hardtop and soft-top versatility, including a sliding rear window and rear defroster. The 8.4 Radio & Premium Audio Group upgrades the cabin with navigation, HD Radio, satellite radio, Bluetooth, telematics and a premium audio system. The LED Lighting Group adds LED headlights, fog lamps and daytime running lights for improved visibility and a modern appearance. The Safety Group brings Blind Spot Monitoring, Cross-Traffic Alert and Rear Park Assist, while the Advanced Safety Group adds Automatic High Beams and Forward Collision Mitigation with Brake Assist.

Comfort gets an upgrade with the Cold Weather Group, featuring heated front seats and a heated steering wheel. The Trailer Tow Package adds the equipment needed to make better use of the Gladiator's truck capability, including a tow hitch and backup camera, while the Auxiliary Switch Group provides factory-integrated controls that make adding compatible accessories and off-road equipment cleaner and easier. Finally, Quick Order Package 24D establishes the Mojave equipment configuration and complements this truck's purpose-built combination of rugged capability and distinctive styling.

The options don't stop there. This Gladiator also features leather seating, a Mopar hardtop headliner, Mopar bright door sills, Mopar grab handles, Trail Rail Management System, tonneau cover, bed liner, body-color fender flares, Mopar satin-black grille, remote start, keyless entry/start, automatic climate control and aluminum wheels. With its removable-top Jeep personality, usable pickup bed, 4WD capability and extensive list of premium equipment, this Gladiator offers a combination that's tough to duplicate.

This 2023 Jeep Grand Cherokee Overland in Black represents a premium three-row SUV that combines capability with refined comfort, offering the versatility you need without compromising on daily driving satisfaction.

The exterior presents a striking appearance with its Black finish complemented by diamond-cut 20-inch aluminum wheels. This Overland model wears its design confidently, combining purposeful lines with refined details that distinguish it in any setting. The full complement of exterior features including auto-dimming mirrors, fog lights, and automatic headlights with delay-off capability ensures you're prepared for any driving condition.

Step inside and you'll find an environment designed for long-term comfort and control. The leather-appointed cabin features heated and cooled front seats along with heated rear seats, providing climate-managed comfort for all passengers throughout the year. Heated steering wheel functionality adds another layer of convenience during cold weather. A power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, while heated door mirrors and rain-sensing wipers demonstrate the attention to practical amenities. The 10-speaker audio system pairs with SiriusXM 360L integration for comprehensive entertainment options.

Technology integration centers on the Uconnect 5 Nav system with its 10.1-inch touchscreen display, offering navigation, audio memory functions, and seamless smartphone connectivity through Bluetooth. Push-to-start ignition, remote keyless entry, and memory seat settings personalize your driving experience. A backup camera aids parking maneuvers with added confidence.

Under the hood, the 3.6L V6 engine with 8-speed automatic transmission and 4WD capability delivers balanced performance across city and highway conditions, achieving 19 city and 26 highway MPG. The integrated tow package supports your hauling requirements, while the adaptive suspension system and four-wheel independent suspension geometry provide composed handling across varied terrain. Electronic stability control, brake assist, and an comprehensive airbag system form a foundation of proactive safety.

As a single-owner vehicle backed by a Carfax Accident Free history and protected by a lifetime powertrain warranty, this Grand Cherokee Overland has been meticulously maintained and represents genuine value. We welcome you to visit our showroom to examine this capable SUV firsthand.
